text: さんまの　しおやき！
note: Salt-grilled Pacific saury (sanma no shioyaki) is a cheap, everyday Japanese home dish, typical of autumn, so it is a comically humble choice for a luxury liner. The English game replaced it with "Eels au Barbecue".
claim: Sanma no shioyaki, salt-grilled Pacific saury, is a common inexpensive autumn dish in Japan.

check.quote: For a long time, sanma was regarded as an inexpensive, everyday fish, eaten in the lean days before payday.
